questions: batch-measurement#r42 with #r57: does the totals' `sessions` count include the session of a stage whose session.json is empty? Reading A, count it: the stage ran in a session that log.jsonl names, so `sessions` is the number of distinct sessions of the stages given. A measurement with one good stage and one empty-session.json stage gives sessions 2, while turns, tokens and cost total only the good stage. Reading B, count only sessions with figures (today's rule, which counts a session only when its session.json gave turns): the same measurement gives sessions 1, so `sessions` matches the sessions the turns, tokens and cost were summed over. Under either reading, a stage with a start and no end and no session.json is counted the same way as the empty case.
